summary: Backend-only iter7 testing. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_features.py — 13 tests, all PASS. Coverage: (1) GET /api/team/me returns owner shape with role='owner', is_staff=False and full permissions list containing edit_trip/delete_trip/edit_invoice/delete_invoice/edit_master/delete_master/manage_users. (2) POST /api/team creates accountant, GET /api/team lists it. (3) Duplicate POST (same email) → 400. (4) POST with role='owner' silently downgraded to 'accountant' — verified via response body. (5) PUT /api/team/{id} updates role to 'viewer'. (6) DELETE /api/team/{id} removes. (7) Supplier P&L: created supplier vehicle VEH-SPL (supplier_name='XYZ Transport') + 2 trips of freight=25000 & supplier_freight=18000. GET /api/reports/supplier-pl returns XYZ Transport row with trips=2, customer_freight=50000, supplier_freight=36000, profit=14000, margin_pct=28.0. (8) Date filter (2020) excludes trips — XYZ absent from suppliers. (9) Invoice snapshot: PUT /api/invoices/{id} with reason+gst_type='igst' auto-creates FileRef; GET /api/files?linked_type=invoice&linked_id=<id> returns >=1 file with category='invoice_snapshot', content_type='application/pdf', size>2000, original_filename contains invoice_number and date. (10) Owner DELETE trip with reason still works (regression). (11) Backward-compat: /auth/me, /customers, /trips, /invoices, /drivers, /products, /vehicles, /dashboard, /company, /audit-logs, /team, /team/me, /reports/supplier-pl, /files all 200. (12) Trip PUT after invoicing still recomputes linked invoice subtotal. (13) audit-logs listing OK. Full iter5+iter6 regression: 28/28 PASS.

minor.issue: TeamMember pydantic model requires owner_user_id but endpoint overwrites it — the field is not truly required from client. Consider making it a server-derived field (Field(exclude=True) or use a separate request model) so clients don't need to send a dummy value.
Staff (is_staff=True) users are hard-403 from viewing team. Accountants who legitimately need to see who they're working under get 403 — consider allowing GET for staff, only 403 on write operations.

Snapshot generation is wrapped in try/except and logs a warning on failure but returns 200 — user has no signal that the snapshot was not saved. Consider returning snapshot_file_id (or snapshot_error) in the response for observability.

A snapshot is written on EVERY PUT, even when payload changes nothing (e.g. only 'reason' provided or the same gst_type re-sent). This will grow db.files quickly for repeat edits. Consider only snapshotting when 'updates' dict is non-empty.

Empty date-range still returns period.start/end as None (not the passed values) when filter matches nothing? Actually it echoes the passed values; but note: when suppliers array is empty, totals object is returned WITHOUT the 'tons' field zeroed only after the empty loop — verified 0 in tests. No issue.
Silent downgrade of role='owner' → 'accountant' has no signal to the caller. Per spec this is intentional, but consider returning a warning header/field so the UI can inform the operator.

action_items: Consider suppressing snapshot creation on no-op PUT /api/invoices/{id} (only when 'updates' dict is non-empty) to avoid unbounded db.files growth.
Consider returning snapshot metadata (file id / error) in PUT /api/invoices/{id} response instead of best-effort silent try/except.
server.py is now ~1995 lines — increasingly urgent to split into routers (team, reports, files, invoices, trips, audit, master).
critical_code_review_comments: TeamMember model doubles as request payload AND storage doc. Endpoint has to reassign owner_user_id (line 1887) because clients must pass a dummy value to satisfy the required field. Split into TeamMemberCreate (client payload) and TeamMember (persistence).

get_current_user does a team_members lookup on EVERY authenticated request. For high traffic, add an index on {email:1, active:1} and consider caching within the request lifecycle. Also, this lookup means when an owner registers themselves as a team member of ANOTHER owner (edge case), they will get scoped away — validate that scenario is prevented on POST /api/team.

role assignment: `user.get('effective_role') or 'owner'` — if a user has NO team_members entry (regular owner), effective_role='owner' is correctly set on line 303. But `.get('effective_role') or 'owner'` also defaults to 'owner' if the value is empty string, which is safe here but slightly ambiguous.
PUT /api/invoices/{id} snapshot: 'invoice_snapshot' rows accumulate on every edit (even trivial ones). Add a size cap, retention policy, or de-dupe by (invoice_id, content_hash).

PUT /api/invoices/{id} snapshot path uses uuid4().hex — good — but storage_path template `{APP_NAME}/uploads/{user_id}/{uuid}.pdf` doesn't include /invoices/ prefix. Future categories could collide semantically; consider `{APP_NAME}/uploads/{user_id}/invoices/{iid}/{uuid}.pdf`.
Supplier P&L report: aggregation is done in Python by iterating all matching trips. For large tenants, push to MongoDB $group aggregation.
Supplier P&L 'margin_pct' rounds to 2 decimals via Python round() — banker's rounding may produce 27.99 vs 28.0 in edge cases. Currently tests pass with exact 28.0.

team endpoints: DELETE hard-deletes rather than soft-deleting (set active=False). Historical audit references remain by entity_id, but if a staff member is deleted and re-added, their user_id/scope tie is lost. Consider soft-delete + reactivation flow.
InvoiceUpdateRequest still has duplicated field declarations (server.py:648-658) — flagged in iter6 report, not yet fixed.
MongoDB _id properly excluded across new endpoints (/team, /team/me, /reports/supplier-pl, /files) — good.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_bitumen_2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). /api/auth/me and /api/team/me both returned 200. Owner user_id=test-user-bitumen.
seed_data_creation: test_iter7_accountant@x.com and test_iter7_boss@x.com team members (cleaned via teardown); VEH-SPL supplier vehicle with supplier_name='XYZ Transport' + 2 trips (freight 25000, supplier_freight 18000) — cleaned; 1 invoice + 1 trip for snapshot test (cleaned); TEST_iter7_*-prefixed customers (cleaned). Snapshot creates FileRef entries in db.files that remain (not deleted by test); each snapshot ~4-6KB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter7 fully verified for owner-side flows. Staff-scope resolution (get_current_user resolving team_member email to owner's user_id + effective_role) is NOT tested here — per review request this requires seeding a second user_sessions row for a user whose email matches a team_members.email row. To test: 1) POST /api/team {email:'staffX@t.com', role:'accountant'} as owner; 2) mongo-insert a user with email='staffX@t.com' and user_id!='test-user-bitumen'; 3) insert a user_sessions row with a new token; 4) call /api/team/me with that token — should return role='accountant', is_staff=true, permissions=[edit_invoice, edit_master, edit_trip]. Then verify GET /api/trips returns owner's trips (scope override) and DELETE /api/trips/{id}?reason=x returns 403 (viewer/accountant lacks delete_trip). Also verify PUT /api/invoices/{id} always writes a new invoice_snapshot file even when only reason is provided (no semantic change) — this is intentional per current impl but may accumulate.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iter7 scope. All acceptance criteria met: team CRUD works; owner-role elevation blocked (silent downgrade to accountant); Supplier P&L aggregates correctly with exact 28% margin; invoice snapshot writes a valid PDF (>2000 bytes) with correct linked_type/linked_id/category/content_type and filename containing invoice_number and ISO date; regression clean.
